name: OpenClaw Learning Memory
description: Always-on memory: a context engine that injects a curated MEMORY.md + USER.md into every agent turn (including group/channel sessions), so bots keep context and rules instead of forgetting them.
author: dongphuongman

charBudget.description: Max characters of memory injected per turn (curated files + recent daily logs). Overflow is trimmed.

files.description: Curated workspace files (relative to the agent workspace) injected every turn, in order.

memoryDir.description: Directory (relative to workspace) holding real-time daily logs (memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md). Their most recent entries are injected so 'remember this' works instantly, before the dreaming cron folds them into MEMORY.md.

recentDays.description: How many of the most recent daily log files to inject (0 to disable).

header.description: Optional heading text placed above the injected memory block.

groupMemory.description: Enable per-group memory injection. When a group session is detected, reads memory/group-<groupId>.md and appends it.

groupMemoryPattern.description: Path template for group memory files (relative to workspace). {groupId} is replaced with the group identifier.

groupBudgetRatio.description: Max fraction of charBudget reserved for group memory (0-1). If group content is smaller, unused space goes to shared memory and vice versa.
